scenes.title: Single Row Subqueries
scenes.narration: A single row subquery is an inner query nested inside another query that returns exactly one value for the outer query to work with.

scenes.title: What defines a single row subquery
bullets: The inner query returns exactly one row and one column.
The outer query treats that result as a single scalar value.
It appears inside WHERE, HAVING, or the SELECT list.
scenes.narration: Because the inner query returns exactly one row and one column, the database can substitute its result directly as a value. The outer query then treats that value like any literal number or string it could compare against. You will most often see these subqueries embedded in a WHERE clause, a HAVING clause, or even the SELECT list.

scenes.title: How the engine evaluates it
steps: Reduce its result to a single scalar value
Substitute that value into the outer query
Evaluate the outer query with the resolved value
scenes.narration: The engine begins by running the inner subquery and reducing it to a single scalar value. That value is then substituted into the outer query as though you had typed it in yourself. Finally the outer query runs to completion using the resolved value.

scenes.title: Employees earning above the company average
scenes.narration: The inner subquery computes the average salary across all employees, which is guaranteed to be a single value because AVG returns one number. The outer query then compares each employee's salary against that single value. Only rows where the salary exceeds the company average are returned.

scenes.text: If a single row subquery accidentally returns more than one row, the database raises an error such as 'subquery returns more than one row'. Use aggregates or a tight filter to guarantee one value.
scenes.narration: Keep in mind that these comparison operators expect exactly one value, so if the subquery returns multiple rows the database will throw an error. Guard against this by using an aggregate function or a filter that guarantees a single result.
